clips.name: think_scratch_head

origin.layer_policy: independent SAM2 objects, explicit visibility gate, alpha union for final frames
origin.sampling: SAM2 every native source frame, then nearest-timestamp delivery selection; no interpolation

alpha_postprocess.method: Black-background effect unpremultiply: RGB / relative blue P90, alpha * relative blue P90
alpha_postprocess.shape_source: Independent real SAM2.1 question object; support never expanded
alpha_postprocess.overlap_cleanup: Primary-mask overlap removed only within real question support dilated two pixels; anatomy outside support unchanged
limitations: Estimated alpha assumes source RGB effect was composited onto black
Very dark codec values cannot recover exact original colors
Earliest tiny question at native44 has no independent SAM2 mask; no invented replacement

hair_background_repair.method: real SAM2.1 locally prompted hair-gap tracking, constrained by white/black source-color matte and blue-hair protection; remove only those independent masks from pre-existing real character alpha; fixed 0.35-native-pixel hole feather
hair_background_repair.disconnected_mask_islands: only largest local component retained per tracked gap; raw masks preserved separately
hair_background_repair.color_method: fixed first-frame blue palette LUT, 75 percent conservative blend to source artwork; skin/neutral whites/black outlines excluded; no per-frame recalibration
hair_background_repair.inner_white_edge_decontamination: invert source-white compositing only inside tracked left hair gaps where alpha was reduced; no global erosion or blue-hair core changes
hair_background_repair.saturation_aware_blue_hair_protection: blue RGB differences multiplied by fixed saturation membership: <=20% not classified as hair, >=40% fully eligible
hair_background_repair.codec_pastel_white_residue: low-saturation purple source-white compression residues removed as part of gap matte

assertions: real frame count decoded and cached
steady playback advances cached frames without load/layout
pointer drag freezes clock/pose; smooth return precedes frame resume
50..200% keep frame/canvas visible; stop frees logical caches and restores chosen static
clips.completion: returned to selected static and idle

RSS includes Qt/native allocations and is not guaranteed to fall immediately after cache release.
240 MiB for 60 raw frames / 384 MiB for 96 raw frames excludes scaled caches and process baseline.
This script does not certify visual identity, segmentation edge quality, or native Windows compositor behavior.
